title: blechnum austrocaledonicum
intro: Blechnum austrocaledonicum, commonly known as the New Caledonian water fern, is a species of fern in the family Blechnaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Blechnum austrocaledonicum are attributed to its ability to lower body temperature, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
